info.title: Scrape Agent
info.x-guidance: Send POST to /api/scrape/x402 with JSON body containing url (string, required) and optional extract (text|html|links|meta|full). Requires $0.01 USDC payment on Base via x402 v2. On 402 response, pay using X-PAYMENT header and retry.

x402Payment.name: X-PAYMENT
x402Payment.description: x402 micropayment — send 0.01 USDC on Base

post.description: Scrapes any public URL and returns clean text, links or HTML. Costs $0.01 USDC per request via x402 on Base.
